name: Putra Harapan Tafonao
description:
Saya adalah mahasiswa Teknik Informatika yang memiliki passion mendalam di bidang rekayasa perangkat lunak. Saya berpengalaman membangun aplikasi full-stack web menggunakan ekosistem PHP (Laravel) & JavaScript, serta pengembang mobile menggunakan Flutter.

Saya aktif mengeksplorasi integrasi AI (seperti LLM API), keamanan sistem informasi, serta arsitektur kode berbasis Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & RESTful API.
description_en:
I am an Informatics Engineering student with a deep passion for software engineering. I have experience building full-stack web applications using the PHP (Laravel) & JavaScript ecosystem, as well as mobile development using Flutter.

I am actively exploring AI integration (such as LLM APIs), information systems security, and code architectures based on Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & RESTful APIs.
